met_criteria: 1. back/tools/audit_drift.py exists and runs via `python back/tools/audit_drift.py --days 30`
2. Tool completes without error and produces drift_*.json in back/tools/audit_outputs/
3. 'trajectories' contains all 7 state fields + 6 growth fields, each with 31 data points (seed + 30 days)
5. 'drift_verdicts' has one entry per dimension, each with 'status' (pass/warn/fail) and 'reasons' list
9. test_rising_10_consecutive_days_flagged and test_falling_10_consecutive_days_flagged verify 10+ day monotonic detection
11. test_monotone_nondecreasing_7_days_flagged verifies residual stacking over 7+ consecutive days
12. TestEndToEndAudit class (9 tests) runs full 30-day backbone audit and verifies JSON structure
13. Full test suite passes: 1061 tests, no regressions
non_blocking_suggestions: test_all_zeros_not_flagged is misleadingly named — the test body correctly asserts flagged_monotone=True (zeros ARE flagged), but the test name implies no flags. Rename to test_all_zeros_flagged_monotone_but_not_max_exceeded for clarity.

detect_monotonic_drift sets streak_start = i-1 when a new direction begins, which can cause reported start_idx to be off by one when preceded by a flat value. This does not affect detection correctness but can produce slightly inaccurate span boundaries in the JSON report.

The saturation_lock window parameter in build_dimension_verdict defaults to saturation_lock_window=5, which matches the default ceiling/floor thresholds. Consider adding a note that the defaults were chosen against the known [7, 93] model value range.
rationale: All 13 acceptance criteria are satisfied. The new files (audit_drift.py, test_p33_t5_drift_audit.py) are the only changes — no existing files were modified. The drift-detection pure functions are algorithmically correct: monotonic detection uses sign-of-delta and correctly breaks streaks on oscillations or flat steps (no false positives on oscillating trajectories confirmed). Saturation-lock detection correctly resets streak count on any dip below threshold (strict consecutive behavior). Residual stacking reads from DaySnapshot.pending_residuals with correct count extraction. No LLM imports or clients are present. Test coverage includes edge cases: empty inputs, single-value inputs, exactly-at-threshold values (|30| is NOT > 30), and exact-window-length streaks. The JSON output is pure machine-readable JSON with no embedded markdown. The full test suite (1061 tests) passes with zero regressions.
